'''2011 US Nationals Veers LS Rebel Strike Team (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Veers]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team (V) / Garrison Destroyed (V)|VB7-L-rebelstriketeam-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jim
* '''Deck name:''' Rebel Strike Team
* '''Username:''' Veers
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
